notes:
CRM notes:
- Account: Sparrowridge Logic — mid-market B2B productivity SaaS (team-focused doc + task automation).
- Use-case summary: primary is in-product chat assistant (context window ~3k tokens) + vector search for docs + code-assist snippets. Reranking candidate results for search is secondary.
- Performance targets: 95p latency <= 200ms for chat UI (user-experienced tokens), sustained throughput ~20-40 chat reqs/s peak; background batch embedding jobs ~200 reqs/hr. Cost sensitivity: medium — will trade off slight latency for lower token cost on non-real-time pipelines.
- Preferred models: open model family (Llama/variants) acceptable; want verified perf profiles. Interested in quantized model variants for Dedicated.
- Evaluation path: started with Hosted API to validate quality and prompt flows. After promising results, asked for Dedicated pricing + VPC options for production. Will run 2-week Dedicated POC (staging).
- Security review: SecOps flagged requirements: SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO/SAML integration (Okta), detailed audit logs (API-level + token-level traces), retention controls (ability to set data retention windows per route), KMS encryption at rest and in transit, region residency: US primary, EU for EU customers. Must confirm Dedicated supports VPC peering + no shared-data retention by default.
- Quotes from CTO (Samir Patel): "We can't route PII through shared tenancy for production — need clear isolation and key ownership options."
- Pricing: asked for 12-month committed Dedicated price band and burst allowances. Finance wants unit economics (cost/token) under committed tier for modeling.
- Internal stakeholders: Product lead (Maya Chen), CTO (Samir Patel), Infra/Net Eng (Ravi Singh), Security (Olivia Park), Procurement (TBD).
- Sticky notes: customer asked for example rollout plan (canary -> full) and rollback behavior when model regression detected. Redwood SE to provide runbook and canary config template.
- Links: see meeting notes and POC artifacts below.
- Short-term plan: security deep-dive, provide SOC2 docs and SAML test app, share Dedicated pricing spreadsheet, schedule network workshop for VPC peering details.
- Long-term: likely Dedicated for US workloads + Private (EU) for EU customer subset if residency checks out.
